prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web application direction mockup for a 1440px expert review workstation
Primary request: Create a mature, production-ready expert page curation and document review interface following established data-labeling and document-audit product conventions. This is an internal workbench, not a marketing page.
Scene/backdrop: full-browser desktop application canvas, landscape 3:2 aspect ratio, straight-on orthographic UI view, no device frame and no surrounding environment.
Composition/framing: strict three-column application layout beneath one compact top bar. Left column is narrow and contains page thumbnail navigation plus filters. Center column is the largest and shows a faithful standard-page render on a pale neutral canvas. Right column is a dense structured editor. A slim keyboard shortcut bar spans the bottom. Show the whole app at once with crisp alignment and balanced density suitable for 1440px desktop use.
Top bar: show document name “季度经营复盘_脱敏版.pptx”, version “v3”, progress “12 / 36 页”, a clear status/progress treatment, and distinct compact actions “批准此页” and “排除此页”.
Left column: compact header “页面”, filters for “全部 / 待审核 / 已批准 / 已排除”, a vertical stack of small slide thumbnails numbered 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, with page 12 selected in blue. Include clear status icons or text so state is not conveyed by color alone.
Center standard-page render: a polished but anonymized Chinese business presentation slide. Title “区域业务结构与季度趋势”. Include abstract blue bar and line charts, a concise business data table, small legend labels, and exactly three numbered visual object bounding boxes labeled “01”, “02”, “03” around the main chart, secondary chart, and table. Keep the slide readable as evidence and visually distinct from the app shell.
Right structured editor: header with explicit status “PENDING · 待审核”. Use compact accessible form controls with these visible sections in this order: “页面总述”, “视觉对象 01”, “视觉对象 02”, “视觉对象 03”. For each visual object show a clear segmented or radio decision “纳入 / 排除”. Show a field labeled “summary”. Include a visible warning badge “未确认草稿” attached to draft content, plus a concise blocker/pending note. Use bordered inputs, textarea fields, labels above controls, and compact disclosure rows; all controls should look realistically implementable in HTML/CSS.
Bottom bar: keyboard shortcuts such as “J/K 切换页面”, “A 批准”, “X 排除”, “E 编辑”, “⌘ Enter 保存”.
Style/medium: shippable high-fidelity SaaS desktop UI mockup, mature neutral enterprise application shell, crisp vector-like interface rendering, precise typography, tight spacing, fine 1px dividers, compact control heights, restrained shadows only where structurally necessary.
Color palette: background #F7F8FA, primary ink #172033, action blue #3867D6, borders #DCE2EA, white surfaces. Use accessible contrast and never rely on color alone.
Information design: expert-dense but calm, strong hierarchy, consistent 8px spacing rhythm, precise baseline alignment, clear focus/selected state, generous enough hit targets, keyboard-first cues.
Text (verbatim where prominent): “季度经营复盘_脱敏版.pptx”, “v3”, “12 / 36 页”, “批准此页”, “排除此页”, “页面”, “区域业务结构与季度趋势”, “PENDING · 待审核”, “页面总述”, “视觉对象 01”, “视觉对象 02”, “视觉对象 03”, “纳入”, “排除”, “summary”, “未确认草稿”, “J/K 切换页面”, “A 批准”, “X 排除”, “E 编辑”, “⌘ Enter 保存”.
Constraints: strict three-column layout; central page render is clearly the dominant evidence area; exactly three numbered object boxes on the slide; visible document/version/progress/actions; visible pending and unconfirmed-draft semantics; controls must appear feasible in ordinary HTML/CSS; high polish without decorative excess.
Avoid: brand concepts, logos, gradients, glassmorphism, glow, oversized rounded cards, pill overload, huge typography, marketing hero composition, people, photos, photographic backgrounds, 3D perspective, device mockups, neon, fantasy UI, illegible microtext, duplicated panels, floating decorative shapes, watermark.
